lines.say: Can you lose fat and build muscle at the same time?
In one study, men ate less and trained hard for four weeks.
The group eating lots of protein gained over a kilo of muscle, and lost almost five kilos of fat.
It works best for beginners, people coming back after a break, and people with more fat to lose.
The recipe: lift heavy, eat plenty of protein, and keep the calorie deficit small.
Very lean, experienced lifters? It gets much slower. That's when bulk and cut makes sense.
